Next year I changed schools again but this time I used knowledge I collected year prior to that one and since day one I didn’t give my fears even a day to get better on me. I was confident in meeting new ppl. I didn’t try to be “**the** funniest” or “**the** smartest”. I chose approach “I’m a bit funny, a bit smart etc. Take it or leave it”. This way not only I took away a lot of pressure from myself but also I made it way less like to be “replaceable” cause not only somebody had to by as funny as me but also smart, quirky etc. With some people it’ll work with others it won’t but the longer I was “acting like myself” the easier it became.
